comparison.objective: Clear snapped filament from a 3D-printer extruder and discard it.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring lever open while pulling a constrained slender rod, then release and dispose.
comparison.success_condition: Filament fully removed and in tray, lever restored, arms returned, held still for 1 s; partial credit for extraction progress.
comparison.reason: Tests coupled lever actuation and linear extraction, not many-body sifting or retentate preservation.
